hints.title: Formulaic Gray Mapping
hints.text: The standard n-bit reflected Gray code of integer i can be computed directly using bitwise operations: i xor (i shifted right by 1).

hints.title: Consecutive Value Bit Invariance
hints.text: Notice that for any consecutive integers i and i plus one, the terms i xor (i >> 1) and (i + 1) xor ((i + 1) >> 1) differ in exactly one bit position.

hints.title: Direct Range Iteration
hints.text: Compute 1 shifted left by n total elements. Generate each element from index i = 0 up to 2^n - 1 by evaluating i xor (i >> 1).

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(2^N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph searching or recursive backtracking adds unnecessary call overhead when closed-form formula exists.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Formula i XOR (i >> 1) generates the sequence directly in O(2^N) steps without auxiliary hash sets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the direct conversion formula or inductive prefix-reflection construction.
